   "source": [
    "### __- Importation des librairies__"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "b47bf679",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import os\n",
    "import math\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import tensorflow as tf\n",
    "from tensorflow import keras\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from sklearn.metrics import classification_report"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "17fad63a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "<br>\n",
    "\n",
    "### __*- Prétraitement des données pour le COVID-19 X-ray dataset*__   \n",
    "* __Uniformiser toutes les images à la même taille (128 x 128).__\n",
    "\n",
    "* __Normaliser les pixels entre 0 et 1.__\n",
    "\n",
    "* __Diviser les données : ( 70% → Entraînement,  30% → Validation,  10% → Test)__\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "<br>\n",
    "<br>\n",
    "<hr>\n",
    "\n",
    "* __*Vous pouvez tester le site XrayAi :*__  https://covid-xray-ai.streamlit.app/\n",
    "* __*Dataset Kaggle :*__ https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/khoongweihao/covid19-xray-dataset-train-test-sets\n",
    "\n",
    "<hr>\n",
    "\n",
    "##### Dataset pour évolution future : \n",
    "* __*COVID-19 Radiography Database :*__ https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/andyczhao/covidx-cxr2\n",
    "* __*COVID-19 Radiography Database  :*__ https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/amanullahasraf/covid19-pneumonia-normal-chest-xray-pa-dataset\n",
    "\n",
    "<hr>"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "90612742",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Found 148 files belonging to 2 classes.\n",
      "Found 40 files belonging to 2 classes.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "\n",
    "# Paramètres\n",
    "IMG_SIZE = 128\n",
    "BATCH_SIZE = 16\n",
    "data_dir = \"data/xray_dataset_covid19\"\n",
    "AUTOTUNE = tf.data.AUTOTUNE\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# prétraitement d'images unifiée\n",
    "def preprocess_image(img, label, is_training=True):\n",
    "    img = tf.cast(img, tf.float32) / 255.0\n",
    "    if is_training:\n",
    "        img = data_augmentation(img)\n",
    "    return img, label\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Data augmentation\n",
    "data_augmentation = keras.Sequential([\n",
    "    keras.layers.RandomFlip(\"horizontal\"),\n",
    "    keras.layers.RandomRotation(0.1),\n",
    "    keras.layers.RandomZoom(0.1),\n",
    "    #keras.layers.RandomContrast(0.1),\n",
    "\n",
    "])\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Charger le dataset train\n",
    "full_train_ds = tf.keras.utils.image_dataset_from_directory(\n",
    "    f\"{data_dir}/train\",\n",
    "    image_size=(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE),\n",
    "    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,\n",
    "    label_mode='binary',\n",
    "    seed=123,\n",
    "    shuffle=True\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Charger le dataset test\n",
    "test_ds = tf.keras.utils.image_dataset_from_directory(\n",
    "    f\"{data_dir}/test\",\n",
    "    image_size=(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE),\n",
    "    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,\n",
    "    label_mode='binary',\n",
    "    seed=123\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Prétraitement des images\n",
    "full_train_ds = full_train_ds.map(lambda x, y: preprocess_image(x, y, is_training=True))\n",
    "test_ds = test_ds.map(lambda x, y: preprocess_image(x, y, is_training=False))\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Optimisation des performances\n",
    "full_train_ds = full_train_ds.prefetch(buffer_size=AUTOTUNE)\n",
    "test_ds = test_ds.prefetch(buffer_size=AUTOTUNE)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "90b858db",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "<hr>\n",
    "\n",
    "```python\n",
    "\n",
    "    * Les paramètres d’augmentation sont compatibles avec des images normalisées entre 0 et 1\n",
    "    * Avoir des entrées en float32 déjà normalisées aide le modèle à apprendre plus vite et rend l’entraînement plus stable\n",
    "\n",
    "    - (\"c'est pourquoi on normalise avant l'augmentation des données\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "<hr>"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9c7422cc",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "<br>\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "__*2. Normaliser les pixels entre 0 et 1*__"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "23118a83",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "'\\nnormalization_layer = tf.keras.layers.Rescaling(1./255)\\ntrain_ds = train_ds.map(lambda x, y: (normalization_layer(x), y))\\ntest_ds = test_ds.map(lambda x, y: (normalization_layer(x), y))\\n'"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 4,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Référence\n",
    "     # https://keras.io/api/layers/preprocessing_layers/image_preprocessing/rescaling/\n",
    "     # Transformer les pixels de [0, 255] → [0, 1]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Normalisation des données d’entrée\n",
    "'''\n",
    "normalization_layer = tf.keras.layers.Rescaling(1./255)\n",
    "train_ds = train_ds.map(lambda x, y: (normalization_layer(x), y))\n",
    "test_ds = test_ds.map(lambda x, y: (normalization_layer(x), y))\n",
    "'''"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d0b48c0f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "<br>\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "__*3. Je divise par batches. Je prends 70% du dataset train pour l’entrainement et 30% pour la validation et le test set conserver séparément qui contient 10 % de la train set.*__"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "e6458286",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Train batches: 7, Validation batches: 3\n",
      "Test batches: 3\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "'''\n",
    "   - Je prends 0% du dataset train pour l’entrainement \n",
    "   - J’ai pris les derniers 30% pour la validation\n",
    "   - Je conserve le test set séparé qui contient 10% de données.\n",
    "'''\n",
    "\n",
    "AUTOTUNE = tf.data.AUTOTUNE\n",
    "BUFFER_SIZE = 1000\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "shuffled_ds = full_train_ds.shuffle(BUFFER_SIZE, reshuffle_each_iteration=False)\n",
    "batches_complet = tf.data.experimental.cardinality(shuffled_ds).numpy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# 70% train et 30% validation\n",
    "val_batches = int(batches_complet * 0.3)\n",
    "train_batches = batches_complet - val_batches\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Le cas où pour éviter que val_batches = 0\n",
    "if val_batches < 1:\n",
    "    val_batches = 1\n",
    "    train_batches = max(1, batches_complet - 1)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "train_ds = shuffled_ds.take(train_batches).cache().prefetch(buffer_size=AUTOTUNE)\n",
    "val_ds = shuffled_ds.skip(train_batches).take(val_batches).cache().prefetch(buffer_size=AUTOTUNE)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Train batches: {train_batches}, Validation batches: {val_batches}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Test batches: {tf.data.experimental.cardinality(test_ds).numpy()}\")\n"
   ]
  },

    "# Les notes :\n",
    "    # index 0 : NORMAL\n",
    "    # index 1 : PNEUMONIA\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Prendre un seul batch\n",
    "for images, labels in train_ds.take(1):\n",
    "    batch_size = images.shape[0]\n",
    "    print(f\"Affichage d'un batch de {batch_size} images\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Calculer le nombre de lignes et colonnes pour la grille\n",
    "    cols = min(4, batch_size)\n",
    "    rows = math.ceil(batch_size / cols)\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(cols * 2, rows * 2))\n",
    "\n",
    "    for i in range(batch_size):\n",
    "        img = images[i].numpy()\n",
    "\n",
    "        if img.min() < 0:\n",
    "            img = (img + 1) / 2\n",
    "        elif img.max() > 1.0:\n",
    "            img = img / 255.0\n",
    "\n",
    "        plt.subplot(rows, cols, i + 1)\n",
    "        plt.imshow(img)\n",
    "        plt.title(\"NORMAL\" if labels[i] == 0 else \"PNEUMONIA\")\n",
    "        plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "    break"
   ]

    "<br>\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "### __- Construction du modèle CNN__"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "id": "f25c8507",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Référence pour le modèle CNN\n",
    "    # https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jDe5BAsT2-Y\n",
    "    # https://medium.com/@myringoleMLGOD/simple-convolutional-neural-network-cnn-for-dummies-in-pytorch-a-step-by-step-guide-6f4109f6df80\n",
    "    # https://victorzhou.com/blog/intro-to-cnns-part-1/\n",
    "    # https://medium.com/thedeephub/convolutional-neural-networks-a-comprehensive-guide-5cc0b5eae175\n",
    "\n",
    "# Padding images cnn\n",
    "    # https://learnopencv.com/understanding-convolutional-neural-networks-cnn/\n",
    "    # https://medium.com/thedeephub/convolutional-neural-networks-a-comprehensive-guide-5cc0b5eae175\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "import keras\n",
    "from keras.models import Sequential\n",
    "from keras.layers import Conv2D, MaxPooling2D, Flatten, Dense, Dropout, Input\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def covid_cnn_model(input_shape=(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE, 3), num_classes=1):\n",
    "    model = Sequential([\n",
    "        Input(shape=input_shape),\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Bloc Conv 1\n",
    "        Conv2D(32, (3, 3), activation='relu', padding='same'),\n",
    "        #keras.layers.BatchNormalization(),\n",
    "        MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Bloc Conv 2\n",
    "        Conv2D(64, (3, 3), activation='relu', padding='same'),\n",
    "        #keras.layers.BatchNormalization(),\n",
    "        MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Bloc Conv 3\n",
    "        Conv2D(128, (3, 3), activation='relu', padding='same'),\n",
    "        #keras.layers.BatchNormalization(),\n",
    "        MaxPooling2D((2, 2)),\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "        Flatten(),\n",
    "        Dense(128, activation='relu'),\n",
    "        Dropout(0.5),\n",
    "        Dense(num_classes, activation='sigmoid')\n",
    "            # sigmoid car c'est une classification binaire\n",
    "    ])\n",
    "    return model\n"
   ]
  },

    "def plot_courbes(history):\n",
    "    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Accuracy\n",
    "    ax1.plot(history.history['accuracy'], label='Train')\n",
    "    ax1.plot(history.history['val_accuracy'], label='Validation')\n",
    "    ax1.set_title('Accuracy')\n",
    "    ax1.legend()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Loss\n",
    "    ax2.plot(history.history['loss'], label='Train')\n",
    "    ax2.plot(history.history['val_loss'], label='Validation')\n",
    "    ax2.set_title('Loss')\n",
    "    ax2.legend()\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "plot_courbes(history)"
   ]

    "from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def plot_confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred):\n",
    "    cm = confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred)\n",
    "    plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))\n",
    "    sns.heatmap(cm, annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='Blues',\n",
    "                xticklabels=['NORMAL', 'COVID'],\n",
    "                yticklabels=['NORMAL', 'COVID'])\n",
    "    plt.title('Matrice de Confusion')\n",
    "    plt.ylabel('Vrai')\n",
    "    plt.xlabel('Prédit')\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# Prédictions\n",
    "y_pred = (model.predict(test_ds) > 0.5).astype(int).flatten()\n",
    "y_true = np.concatenate([y for _, y in test_ds]).flatten()\n",
    "\n",
    "plot_confusion_matrix(y_true, y_pred)"
   ]
  },

    "from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold\n",
    "from scikeras.wrappers import KerasClassifier\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "raw_train_ds = tf.keras.utils.image_dataset_from_directory(\n",
    "    f\"{data_dir}/train\",\n",
    "    image_size=(IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE),\n",
    "    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,\n",
    "    label_mode='binary',\n",
    "    seed=123,\n",
    "    shuffle=False\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Normalisation\n",
    "raw_train_ds = raw_train_ds.map(lambda x, y: (tf.cast(x, tf.float32) / 255.0, y))\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Extraire données\n",
    "X_list, y_list = [], []\n",
    "for images, labels in raw_train_ds.unbatch():\n",
    "    X_list.append(images.numpy())\n",
    "    y_list.append(labels.numpy())\n",
    "\n",
    "X = np.array(X_list)\n",
    "y = np.array(y_list).flatten()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Wrapper de méthode create_model\n",
    "def create_model():\n",
    "    m = covid_cnn_model()\n",
    "    m.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='binary_crossentropy', metrics=['accuracy'])\n",
    "    return m\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Cross-validation\n",
    "skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)\n",
    "clf = KerasClassifier(model=create_model, epochs=10, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, verbose=0)\n",
    "scores = cross_val_score(clf, X, y, cv=skf, scoring='accuracy')\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Scores par fold: {[f'{s:.2%}' for s in scores]}\")\n",
    "print(f\"Moyenne: {scores.mean():.2%}\")"
   ]
  },

    "import threading\n",
    "from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor\n",
    "import tensorflow as tf\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def get_optimizers():\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        'SGD': tf.keras.optimizers.SGD(),\n",
    "        'Adam': tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(),\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def train_parallel(train_ds, val_ds, test_ds, epochs):\n",
    "    def train_one(name, optimizer):\n",
    "        model = covid_cnn_model()\n",
    "        model.compile(optimizer=optimizer, loss='binary_crossentropy', metrics=['accuracy'])\n",
    "        history = model.fit(train_ds, validation_data=val_ds, epochs=epochs, verbose=0)\n",
    "        _, test_acc = model.evaluate(test_ds, verbose=0)\n",
    "        return name, {\n",
    "            'train': history.history['accuracy'][-1],\n",
    "            'val': history.history['val_accuracy'][-1],\n",
    "            'test': test_acc\n",
    "        }\n",
    "    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as ex:\n",
    "        results_list = list(ex.map(lambda x: train_one(*x), get_optimizers().items()))\n",
    "\n",
    "    return {name: metrics for name, metrics in results_list}\n"
   ]
  },

    "\n",
    "def print_results(results):\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\" + \"=\"*50)\n",
    "    print(\"Résultats de performance par optimiseur\")\n",
    "    print(\"=\"*50)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for name, m in sorted(results.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]['test'], reverse=True):\n",
    "        print(f\"{name:10s}: Train= {m['train']:.2%}, Val= {m['val']:.2%}, Test= {m['test']:.2%}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "results = train_parallel(train_ds, val_ds, test_ds, epochs=10)\n",
    "print_results(results)"
   ]
